note: autotk 2.0 目标初始注册表。数据来自旧 popupDetect/alertIntent + 本会话真机实测。ocr 为字符串正则(加载时 new RegExp(pattern,'i'))。region/box 为归一化[0..1]。handler 仅 hazard。见 target-registry-说明.md。

targets.phrase: the Don't Allow button
targets.ocr: don'?t\s*allow|不允许
targets.source: IMG_0008 实测;iOS 定位权限(带地图);VLM 定位 Don't Allow→tap(该窗 /alert 读不到,alert 通道已弃)
targets.notes: 绝不点 Allow Once/Allow While Using App;弯引号 U+2019 已并入正则

targets.phrase: the Ask App Not to Track button
targets.ocr: ask app not to track|不允许跟踪

targets.phrase: the Don't Allow button
targets.ocr: don'?t\s*allow|不允许

targets.phrase: the Cancel button
targets.ocr: ^\s*(cancel|取消)\s*$

targets.phrase: the OK or Allow button
targets.ocr: ^\s*(ok|好|allow|允许)\s*$
targets.source: alertIntent;仅 publish 页允许(发视频需要);养号页不激活
targets.notes: allow=WDA alert 点 好/OK/Allow,排除不允许

targets.phrase: the OK or Allow button
targets.ocr: ^\s*(ok|好|allow|允许)\s*$

targets.phrase: the Allow Access to All Photos button
targets.ocr: allow access to all photos|允许访问所有照片
targets.source: alertIntent;仅 publish;优先全部照片,绝不点含允许子串的不允许

targets.phrase: the close button X below the card
targets.ocr: choose up to this many products|free shipping on all your picks|恭喜.*可(选|挑|领)|立即(挑选|领取)
targets.source: IMG_0002 实测;Shop 促销弹窗,✕ 在卡片下方居中(非右上)

targets.phrase: the close button X at the top-left of the bottom sheet
targets.ocr: scroll up for full\s?screen|full\s?screen view|上滑查看全屏|sign in to continue|登录后.*继续
targets.source: IMG_0007 实测;误点广告开的内嵌网页 sheet,✕ 在左上
targets.notes: ⚠️ 绝不能上滑(会进外部页);只点左上 ✕

targets.phrase: the close X of the login popup
targets.ocr: log\s*in to tiktok|sign\s*up for tiktok|登录后(即可|才能)?

targets.phrase: the Not Now button or close X
targets.ocr: turn on notifications|开启(推送|通知)|don'?t miss out

targets.phrase: the close X
targets.ocr: add yours|添加你的

targets.phrase: the close X at the top-right of the card
targets.ocr: 接收好友新作品通知|好友新作品通知|friends'?\s*new\s*posts?
targets.notes: 红「接收通知」勿点,只点 ✕

targets.phrase: the close X at the top-right of the card
targets.ocr: 虚拟头像|你的专属风格|开始创建|create your tiktok avatar
targets.notes: 「开始创建」勿点

targets.phrase: the Got it or 知道了 button
targets.ocr: 虚拟物品和奖励政策|奖励政策更新|virtual\s*items?.*(policy|reward)
targets.notes: 底部「知道了/Got it」可安全点掉

targets.phrase: the close X at the top-right of the card
targets.ocr: 评论互动时收到通知|与你的评论互动|interact.*with your comment
targets.notes: 红「接收通知」勿点

targets.phrase: the close X at the top-right of the card
targets.ocr: 安全检查|做个安全检查|security\s*check
targets.notes: 红「继续」勿点

targets.phrase: the close X at the top-right of the card
targets.ocr: 通行密钥|iCloud\s*钥匙串|钥匙串|passkey|icloud\s*keychain
targets.notes: 系统 passkey 但呈卡片带 ✕;蓝「设置」勿点

targets.phrase: the Cancel or 暂时不要 button (not 打开设置)
targets.ocr: 允许访问位置|解锁本地瑰宝|查看附近的相关内容|nearby (relevant )?content|allow location access
targets.notes: TikTok 应用内位置推广,非系统窗;点取消/暂时不要,绝不点「打开设置」(会跳出 App)

targets.phrase: the share sheet
targets.ocr: send to|share to|分享到|发送给
targets.notes: 误开的分享面板;下滑或点外部关

targets.phrase: the LIVE (直播中) badge label
targets.ocr: 直播中|\bLIVE\b
targets.notes: 识别到=直播卡,直接盲滑走,不互动

targets.phrase: the sponsored first comment with a Learn more blue button
targets.ocr: sponsored|promoted|赞助|推广|learn more|了解更多|shop now|立即购买
targets.notes: 评论区置顶广告条;不点赞不回复,跳过它

targets.phrase: the right-side action rail with like/comment/save/share icons
the like heart button on the right rail
the comment (speech bubble) button on the right rail
the save/bookmark button on the right rail
the share (arrow) button on the right rail
the red follow plus button below the avatar on the right rail
targets.notes: 已关注则无+,VLM 返回空即跳过

targets.phrase: the Following (关注) tab at the top center
targets.notes: 「关注监控」功能:点它从推荐流跳到关注流。关注流右栏与推荐流一致,靠哪个 Tab 高亮区分

targets.phrase: the For You (推荐) tab at the top center
targets.notes: 在关注流互动完切回推荐流用;也用于纠正误入关注流

targets.phrase: the search magnifier icon in the top bar
the search text input box at the top
the red Search submit button
the search results grid of videos
the second video in the search results (skip the first which is often an ad)
targets.notes: 点第二个,跳过第一个广告位

targets.phrase: the comments panel sliding up from the bottom
the close X in the comments tab bar
targets.notes: 在「评论N|评价M|✕」栏,非顶端地点横幅

targets.phrase: the comment input box at the bottom
the Reply link under a comment
targets.notes: y 随具体评论行

targets.phrase: the like heart of a comment on the right
the send button after typing a reply
the avatar (profile picture) of a specific comment's author on the left
targets.notes: 私信流:点它进该评论者主页。y 随具体评论行

targets.phrase: the comments area (to scroll up for more comments)
targets.notes: 评论下滑:在面板内向上滑一屏加载更多;到底检测靠连续两屏无新评论

targets.phrase: the Message (私信/发消息) button on this user's profile
targets.notes: 🆕 私信:对方主页上的私信按钮。**不存在=对方隐私不可私信→跳过该人**

targets.phrase: the message text input box at the bottom of the chat
targets.notes: 🆕 私信对话页的输入框

targets.phrase: the send button in the chat after typing a message
targets.notes: 🆕 私信发送

targets.phrase: the username/handle at the top of this user's profile
targets.notes: 🆕 读用户名用于去重(StateStore);经 /ocr 读文本

targets.phrase: the Me/我 tab at the bottom right
the profile video grid
the first (top-left) video cell in the profile grid
the back arrow at the top-left
the Home tab at the bottom left
the plus (+) create button at the bottom center
the Upload/相册 entry on the camera page
the first (newest) video in the album
the Next/下一步 button
the caption text input area
the Post/发布 button
the WHITE (not-yet-liked) heart like button on the right rail
targets.notes: 只有白色未点赞才存在;已点赞是红心→本目标缺席→跳过,避免再点=取消赞

targets.phrase: the WHITE (not-yet-saved) bookmark/save button on the right rail
targets.notes: 白色未收藏才存在;已收藏是黄色→缺席→跳过,避免取消收藏

targets.phrase: the Sponsored/Ad label on this full-screen feed video (promoted content)
targets.ocr: sponsored|promoted|广告|赞助|learn more|了解更多
targets.notes: 进流后兼验:整条视频是广告→划走不互动

targets.phrase: the first search-result video thumbnail that is NOT a live stream and NOT a sponsored ad (no LIVE badge, no Ad/Sponsored label)
targets.notes: 结果页优先选它;找不到退回 search.result-2
